announcements.headline: Post Stab Notice - Angola USD Jan 31 & Mar 37
announcements.insight: Following May tender results and June principal corrections, this post-stab notice advances the restructuring process for Angola USD notes.

announcements.headline: Correction of Outstanding Principal of 2028 Notes
announcements.insight: Republic of Angola (The) corrects the outstanding principal of its 2028 Notes following the May tender offer results. Shareholders should monitor subsequent steps in this debt restructuring process.

announcements.headline: Tender Offer Results Announcement
announcements.insight: Republic of Angola (The) has published tender offer results. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent court sanction filings to finalize the transaction.
